deployment.method: Cloudflare connector API; no CLI credential used for deployment

source.canonical_release: GitHub cloudflare/worker.mjs and online/; earlier uncommitted local drafts are not this release

passed_observations: Live /health loaded in a Cloudflare browser and reported the expected revision and maxPlayers=3.
Online page loaded the pinned original HTML, passed its Git blob guard, and created a Three.js r169 canvas.
Three real browser WebSocket clients joined one random room; initial rosters were 0, 1 and 2 other players.
A position sent by one client was observed by another.
Skin changes and room chat were received by another client.
Two clients requested the same fruit; exactly one got it and the other was denied.
Shared house progress was received by another client.
In an isolated feeding retest, the feed patch arrived at 790 ms and produce at 2289 ms; a later joining client saw the same produce in its snapshot.
not_passed_or_not_completed: The first combined protocol run timed out waiting 8 seconds for produce, after passing its earlier multiplayer checks. This remains an unresolved observation, not silently converted to a pass.

The initial browser test URL was subsequently confirmed to redirect into the classroom HUB; an inert qa.html was added to avoid that interference. The redirect is a potential test-environment factor, not proof that it explains every timeout.
Further full browser-regression and UI-click instrumentation calls returned Cloudflare Browser Rendering error 6002 (timeout).

Room isolation, rejoin slot release, reconnect snapshot, 20-second resource respawn, weather and campfire expiry, and all-players-away persistence have implementation paths but did not complete the combined acceptance run.
Three simultaneously running full graphical game clients were not verified.
Physical iPads, Safari touch controls, and connections from three independent home networks were not tested.

operating_boundaries.room_access: 96-bit random invite code; anyone holding the invite can join until full; not verified membership authentication
operating_boundaries.free_text_chat: Inherited room chat; no moderation service added. Share invites privately and use nicknames.
operating_boundaries.world_retention_implementation: Shared world retained; seven days after a room becomes empty, its storage is scheduled for deletion. Full retention acceptance is pending.
operating_boundaries.personal_progress: Inventory and personal quest progress remain client-memory state; refreshing is not a persistent personal save.
operating_boundaries.scope: Family/classroom playtest, not an unrestricted public game launch
